note: ev10cs3 (v3, amendment A3 of GATES.md): CANDIDATE eval-10 collision copy for the simulator only (1 Nov 2026, CPU). As ev10cs2 (v2) with 8 sectors instead of 12 for both cups (fewer, larger hand-facing pieces): blue 32 = 24 wall + 1 floor plate (8-gon rings) + 7 ev10 base hulls clipped to h >= h_base; beige 33 = 24 wall + 1 + 8 ring base. Cavity-safe inner faces (blue), inscribed outer faces (beige) as v1. NOT packed; measured candidate (README.md).
layout: as meshes/carve/ev10: <obj>/piece_NN.obj (one convex hull each), <obj>/inertia.json (uniform solid of the pieces, 0.3 kg; make_assets.py --pieces reads it), <obj>/lathe_collision.json

pairs_with.frame: the pieces are in the library_v3 mesh (= URDF link) frame, as ev10

critical_frames.nested_hands_off_rest: f124-f160 (all 37 frames have no hand-contact label; gate 1)
critical_frames.pair_scene_gate: f111, f142, f116 (the precheck frames; gate 2)

commands: python -I S/lathe_cavsafe.py PROF/blue_cup_profile.npz PROF/blue_cup.json OUT/blue_cup --seg 8 --band 0.06 --wall 0.003 --base_pieces meshes/carve/ev10/blue_cup --base_first 36 --inner_circ --outer_circ --floor_plate

python -I S/lathe_cavsafe.py PROF/beige_cup_v3_profile.npz PROF/beige_cup_v3.json OUT/beige_cup --seg 8 --band 0.06 --shrink 0.008 --base_to_mesh meshes/library_v3/beige_cup.glb --ext_max 0.0071 --outer_insc
scripts: S = docs/research/mesh-2026-10-26/gmg/build/I/results/ev10-cavsafe/scripts (lathe_cavsafe.py = focused-pascal pipeline/lathe_collision.py blob 680cc2f9 + opt-in options; without them it rebuilds ev10 at vertex Hausdorff 0.0 mm)
environment: Python 3.13, trimesh 5.2.0, numpy 2.5.4, scipy 1.18.1 (HiGHS linprog); profiles regenerated here (their bytes differ from ev10w 4.12.2 profiles, the rebuilt ev10 geometry is identical)
rest_robustness: not run (no FlashCHORD here); see README for what the pack lane should run
